Island 1.1, landmark (a): the three use cases draft

The hub: one English AI system at the centre, a general model on a board with three fine-tuned cards plugged in, coral for the doctor, amber for the taxonomist, mint for the lawyer, each marked English. Each professional’s input goes into the card of their colour, and their decision comes out of the board on that side. The board with three cards is a draft form of the validated system; the rest is the validated concepts, moved. doctor · taxonomist · lawyer · the three elements side by side · concepts
